#!/usr/bin/env python3

# Initial board (rows 0-19, top to bottom)
initial = [
    "0000000000",  # row 0
    "0000000000",  # row 1
    "0000000000",  # row 2
    "0000000000",  # row 3
    "0000000000",  # row 4
    "0000000000",  # row 5
    "0000000000",  # row 6

    "0000000000",  # row 10

    "0000000000",  # row 12
    "0000000000",  # row 13
    "0000010000",  # row 14
    "0001011000",  # row 15
    "0011111000",  # row 16
    "1011111110",  # row 17
    "1111111110",  # row 18
    "1111111110",  # row 19
]

# Garbage holes at columns [3, 3, 5, 2] - oldest first
# Oldest ends up highest within garbage block (i.e., at lower row index in final board)
# In rising garbage, newest is at the bottom (highest row index)
holes = [3, 3, 5, 2]

def make_garbage_row(hole_col):
    return "".join("0" if c == hole_col else "1" for c in range(10))

# Create garbage rows - oldest first, newest last
garbage_rows = [make_garbage_row(h) for h in holes]
print("Garbage rows (oldest to newest):")
for i, g in enumerate(garbage_rows):
    print(f"  Garbage {i} (hole at {holes[i]}): {g}")

# Standard rising-garbage mechanics:
# - Garbage rises from the BOTTOM
# - Existing content shifts UP by 4 rows
# - Garbage occupies the bottom 4 rows (rows 16-19)
# - Oldest garbage is at row 16 (top of garbage block)
# - Newest garbage is at row 19 (bottom)

# Shift existing content UP by 4 rows
# New row i = old row i+4 (for i in 0..15)
# Rows 16-19 are the garbage rows

shifted = ["0000000000"] * 20
for i in range(16):  # rows 0-15 get old rows 4-19
    shifted[i] = initial[i + 4]

# Place garbage at rows 16-19 (oldest at 16, newest at 19)
for i in range(4):
    shifted[16 + i] = garbage_rows[i]

print("\nGold board (20 rows):")
for i, row in enumerate(shifted):
    print(f"Row {i:2d}: {row}")

# Check for clears (rows of all 1s)
cleared_rows = []
for i, row in enumerate(shifted):
    if row == "1111111111":
        cleared_rows.append(i)
        
print(f"\nRows cleared: {cleared_rows}")

# Write gold board to file
with open("/workspace/gold_board.txt", "w") as f:
    for row in shifted:
        f.write(row + "\n")

print("\nGold board written to /workspace/gold_board.txt")
